_comment: Machine-readable provenance & tunability registry for crystal_lake_v0.json. METADATA ONLY (values live in the artifact). class mirrors the calibration-log Confidence column; `tunable` gates what a future sweep/auto-calibrator may fit; full metadata (min/max/prior/couples_with) is carried only for the tunable set. Kept in sync with the artifact by tests/test_registry.py (completeness + consistency). Companion prose lives in docs/calibration-log.md.

hspf.PERC_coeff.notes: 1 event, 1 season; the GAUGE is the anchor, not the HSPF nominal 0.1. Trades against the Step 6 flood-peak margin -- do not fit on RMSE alone.

hspf.AGWRC_per_day.source: moved off the Ecology Till nominal 0.996 to fit local post-rain lake hold; inside EPA Tech Note 6 typical 0.92-0.99
hspf.AGWRC_per_day.notes: recession half-life ~23 d at 0.97; the seasonal_agw_default_in table is DERIVED from this -- recompute it if AGWRC changes.

spillway.leakage.cfs_per_ft2.source: trimmed to ~0.6 cfs dry-recession once a standing baseflow inflow was modeled; total seam leakage bounded by cfs_low/high 0.5-2.0 cfs
spillway.leakage.cfs_per_ft2.notes: first-order (linear in submerged height, shared across legs); needs a real dry spell to calibrate the split and head dependence.

seasonal_agw_default_in.source: recharge-fraction estimate (Bauer & Mastin 1997, ~13-23% of precip under forested till)
seasonal_agw_default_in.notes: PROVISIONAL placeholder; DERIVED from AGWRC (recompute if it changes). Tune against gauge dry-spell baseflow + Wolock BFI~0.67. Per-cell tuning deferred (whole-table).

watershed.lag_hours.source: doc '4-5 h' ballpark + one suspect dashboard read
watershed.lag_hours.notes: weakly grounded; a pure translation delay (affects timing, not delivery duration). Rounds to lag_steps=round(lag_hours/dt).

datum.sensor_to_absolute_offset_ft.source: cross-checked from the HA summer_normal helper + a hindcast
datum.sensor_to_absolute_offset_ft.notes: UNCONFIRMED within ~0.12 ft (two soft anchors disagree); propagates to every absolute threshold. Needs a clean crest-crossing field read.

hspf.INTFW.notes: Ecology Till value; currently reserved/unused pending a SURO path (#3).

hspf.INFEXP.notes: HSPF Till nonlinearity; also drives the #3 wetness-driven interflow fraction (SM/LZSN)**INFEXP.

hspf.KVARY_per_in.notes: held at 0 (linear store); Ecology Till is 0.5/in -- enable later (brief D.5).

hspf.DEEPFR.notes: 0.05 low end for a low-relief closed till basin; EPA range 0.0-0.50.

geometry.stage_area.slope.notes: linear area fit; enforced by test_geometry_matches_documented_hard_points (75.1/96.1 ac).

geometry.stage_storage.a.notes: quadratic storage fit; enforced by geometry hard points (131/230/486 ac-ft).

spillway.primary.soffit_elev_ft.notes: INFERRED from the rated 110 cfs; estimate pending a field measurement of the primary opening.

spillway.auxiliary.control_elev_ft.notes: absolute value not independently pinned; relative spacing field-confirmed.

spillway.auxiliary.soffit_elev_ft.notes: measured 2.5 ft above the zero-stop-log datum.

spillway.weir_exponent.notes: 1.5 corroborated (both legs imply C~1.9); enforced by test_m6_physical_crest_lengths_corroborate_reported_capacity. Do NOT change without strong cause.

spillway.overtopping.bridge_deck_elev_ft.notes: EAP-grounded relative 0.5 ft sag->bridge; absolute tied to dam-crest.

seasonal_sm_default_frac_of_lzsn.notes: monthly SM seeding fraction of LZSN (Reference 1.5).

uncertainty.lead_ratio_by_day.notes: PLACEHOLDER low/high precip band by lead; needs the spec-3.5 forecast-vs-gauge fit.

uncertainty.skill_confidence_by_day.notes: PLACEHOLDER QPF-skill-by-lead; ordinal, not a calibrated probability (spec 3.5).

uncertainty.season_spread_factor.notes: PLACEHOLDER seasonal band widener; no independent grounding.

uncertainty.noaa_median_fraction.notes: #2 fix; 0.5 ~ median/high ratio of the day-2/3 band. Tune once spec-3.5 pairs exist.

validation_targets.step6_storm_total_in.notes: HEC-HMS Step 6 design storm; an anchor, not a tunable model parameter.

validation_targets.step6_peak_elev_ft.notes: modeled design-flood cross-check (343.1); revisit as an anchor, don't fit hydrology to it.

validation_targets.dry_equilibrium_3logs.notes: observed dry-equilibrium band 339.6-339.8 -- the one empirically-grounded anchor.

units.CFS_TO_ACFT_PER_HR.notes: physical constant 0.0826 (units.py); not in the artifact -- cannot be --set.

sources.live_ha.LIVE_ANCHOR_WINDOW_HOURS.notes: 30-min live anchor median window; empirically tuned to sensor noise. Do NOT lengthen without re-checking alarm lag.
